laws.statement: A harness fact a shipped plugin depends on must be assertable by a command that exits non-zero when the fact stops holding.

checks.expects: the API probe exits non-zero when a fact is not confirmed

laws.statement: An invariant the kit enforces with a command is checked by driving the production modules and requiring the wrong verdict to be refused, so an enforcement point never rests on a test name or on output a green run prints anyway.

checks.expects: every gate invariant is refused when it is broken

laws.statement: A declared verification command names a file that exists, because a command whose implementation is absent enforces nothing while reading as an enforcement point.

checks.expects: every declared verification command names a file that exists

laws.statement: A rule the kit claims must name a command the manifest declares and whose implementation exists; a rule with no enforcement point is reported as an unverified claim rather than presented as a constraint.

checks.expects: every manifest rule cites a declared verification command whose file exists

laws.statement: A recorded verification names the code it judged as well as the laws it judged, so a status cannot report a clean, verified project over a tree the gate rejects.

checks.expects: the code hash covers file contents and changes when they change

laws.statement: The tool adapter is the only module allowed to import the harness, and a module added later cannot escape the boundary by not being named.

checks.expects: every ratchet test passes, including the boundary falsification case

laws.statement: An approval puts a decision into force only while the decision still hashes to the text the approval recorded, so editing an approved record voids the consent instead of inheriting it.

checks.expects: an edited approved record is refused and its law leaves force

laws.statement: A ratification question reaches the human through the harness user-questions channel carrying the record's own text, and its answer is derived from a selected label rather than interpreted.

checks.expects: the question detail is the record's own text and only the approve label yields consent

laws.statement: A capability the harness provides reaches a logic module as an injected function, so the module remains testable without a deployment.
No file under the ratchet plugin may import the harness except its tool adapter, ratchet-tools.mjs.
A plugin must not register a tool definition whose parameters or output schema was written by hand, because the registry validates those as raw JSON Schema and rejects the author DSL.

checks.expects: no registration call passes a hand-written schema

laws.statement: No shell command mints a consent and no tool argument accepts a caller-composed answer; the CLI can only report which decisions are waiting for a human, and it reports the ones it cannot ratify with the reason.

checks.expects: the consent surface refuses a shell mint, refuses an answer that answers no question, and reports a blocked decision with its reason

laws.statement: Every problem the ratchet emits carries a code from the closed vocabulary in ratchet-schema.mjs; a code invented at a call site is a defect.

checks.expects: every emitted problem code is declared in PROBLEM_CODES

laws.statement: A problem record carries a self-contained message and a subject, so a branch can filter on the subject and a reader can act without opening the source.

checks.expects: every problem record carries a code, a subject and a self-contained message

laws.statement: An operation that produces a report writes it whether it succeeded or failed, because a report that exists only on success cannot record a failure.

checks.expects: a failing compile still writes its report and its ledger event

laws.statement: A verification records the spec hash it judged, so a later reader can tell whether the code is still verified against the laws in force.

checks.expects: changing a law makes the recorded verification stale, and a zero-check verification does not count as verified

laws.statement: Every tool a shipped plugin registers is built with defineTool, including one that takes no arguments.

checks.expects: every registered tool was built with defineTool and declares an output schema

laws.statement: A law in force that declares no check and does not say why is reported as unenforced, because a rule with no enforcement point is an unverified claim.

checks.expects: a law with no check and no stated reason is reported as unenforced

laws.statement: A report reaches a reader whole or not at all, so a crash mid-write cannot be mistaken for a gate that failed.

checks.expects: every artifact write goes through a temporary file and a rename
